title: Behavior Move To Liquid
description: Allows the mob to move into a liquid when on land.

goal_radius.description: Distance in blocks within the mob considers it has reached the goal. This is the "wiggle room" to stop the AI from bouncing back and forth trying to reach a specific spot. Value must be > 0.

material_type.description: The material type of the liquid block to find. Valid values are "Any", "Water", and "Lava".

priority.description: As priority approaches 0, the priority is increased. The higher the priority, the sooner this behavior will be executed as a goal.

search_count.description: The number of randomly selected blocks each tick that the mob will check within its search range and height for a valid block to move to.

search_height.description: Height in blocks the mob will look for the liquid block to move towards Value must be > 0.

search_range.description: The distance in blocks it will look for the liquid block to move towards Value must be > 0.

speed_multiplier.description: Movement speed multiplier of the mob when using this goal.
